text:
Ivy Park: FYI product wants to prefer console-origin sampling hints for quota attribution. current SDKs emit header `x-rw-sample: true|false`. new contract expects `x-rw-sample: json-string` so we need SDK changes + console UX.
Marco Ruiz: That encoding change will break low-level HTTP clients. we should accept both shapes server-side for a migration window.
Janelle Kim: Agreed. platform: accept boolean and JSON-string, emit metric `sampling.header.format` with values `legacy|structured`. plan: 60d accept -> 30d warn -> 30d enforce.
Theo Brown: SDK plan: additive methods only. python/ts/officials add helpers `setSampling({source:'console',rate:0.2})` that stringify. default behavior remains legacy. release minor versions.
Ivy Park: Devex: add per-org toggle "Prefer console sampling" and show example snippets and expected log lines. also surface a migration checklist.
Marco Ruiz: I'll open PRs and tests for header encoding. Janelle, can platform emit tenant-hashed id in warn metric? supports flagged yes.
Janelle Kim: yes, will include hashed tenant in migration warnings.
deploy-bot: policy-service v3.16 canary -> staging. link: <https://ci.redwood/d/2222> :rocket:
Theo Brown: Timeline: PRs this week, sdks next week, console toggle live before warn. update product + support by EOD.
Ivy Park: thanks — I'll draft the migration doc and post to #support.
